Welcome to Cursive Keys! 🔑

Cursive is a connected way of writing: the letters hold hands and your pencil keeps moving.

⚡ Write fasterConnected letters mean fewer pencil lifts.
📜 Read historyLetters, diaries, and documents from the past are written in cursive.
✍️ Sign your nameA signature is your personal mark on the world.
